test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the error in the given sentence and select the correct sentence from the given options.

Petrified wood is type of fossilised wood that exhibits the original details of the wood.

options.text: Petrified wood is a type of fossilised wood that exhibits the original details of the wood.
A petrified wood is type of fossilised wood that exhibits an original details of the wood
The petrified wood is the type of fossilised wood that exhibits a original details of the wood.
Petrified wood is the type of fossilised wood that exhibits a original details of the wood.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**a**" before the term "**type of fossilised wood**."
 
• Singular countable nouns typically require an article ("a" or "an").
 
• The correct phrase should be "**a type of fossilised wood**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in the original sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Petrified wood is a type of fossilised wood that exhibits the original details of the wood."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "A petrified wood is type of fossilised wood that exhibits an original details of the wood"** – This option contains multiple errors, including the use of "A petrified wood" and "an original details."
 
• **Option 3: "The petrified wood is the type of fossilised wood that exhibits a original details of the wood."** – This option incorrectly uses "The petrified wood" and "a original details."
 
• **Option 4: "Petrified wood is the type of fossilised wood that exhibits a original details of the wood."** – This option incorrectly uses "the type" and "a original details."
